system.description:
The seafaring school of Opal's docks and merchant fleets: fast, pragmatic, built for the chaos of a boarding action, and more concerned with winning than with style.

  • Deckhand's Escape: Acrobatic Escape's movement increases to 20ft and ignores difficult terrain.
    • 9th level: Acrobatic Escape also lets you climb, or swing on rigging, ropes and chandeliers, without a check.
  • Dockside Rapport: Advantage on Seamanship checks and on Charisma checks with sailors, dock workers and maritime merchants.
